replay.detail: No replay or durable format change.

schema.detail: No SQL query, DDL, index or migration changes.

rules.detail: Admission, source/canonical rules and fresh effect fences are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond a normal binary swap; no deployment implied.

manual.detail: Uses the existing ST3_INCREMENTAL=off switch; no new configuration or budget changes.

summary: Keep intake evaluation available when incremental skipping is disabled

compatibility.detail: Observer, schedule and scheduled-work stages perform their fatal entry dependency-feed read only when incremental skipping is enabled. With ST3_INCREMENTAL=off every supplied item still evaluates, even when an unrelated feed row cannot be decoded. Off disables skipping; it is not byte-identical to the stages before dependency selection.

recovery.detail: Guarded-item clock/read/due recording, successful evaluation and error/fault/recovery behavior remain. Existing per-item diagnostic feed refresh can still run, conservatively invalidate and ignore its read error when an already clean item is evaluated anyway. Off therefore is neither a SQL-free feed bypass nor a replacement for independent authority checks; other existing stages keep their own feed contracts. A private invalid-UTF8 row control distinguishes enabled fatal entry errors from two disabled passes successfully evaluating every supplied foreign item, retaining the prior fault during enabled-stage failure and recovering it after disabled-mode success. No mutation-certificate, full-pass under500 or production savings proof.
